spans.s: Ved. A woman having excellent hips or going in a graceful way; a lewd girl (?).
p. p. Blooming, blossomed, full-blown; लोध्रद्रुमं सानुमतः प्रफुल्तम् [[

p. p. 
__1 Full-blown, blossoming, blooming; न हि प्रफुल्लं सहकारमेत्य वृक्षान्तरं काङ्क्षति षट्पदाली [[

]]; 7. 11. 
__2 Expanded or dilated like a full-blown flower (as eyes). 
__3 Smiling. 
__4 Shining. 
__5 Gay, cheerful, pleased. 
-Comp. 
-नयन, -नेत्र, -लोचन a. with eyes expanded with joy. 
-वदन a. having a beaming or cheerful countenance, looking cheerful.
